ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly white distal lobes with a broad, solid black central region extending from the base; irregular black mottling along the trailing edge and dense black pigmentation along the lateral margins; distinct black focal patch on the upper interior of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp, acute vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge with numerous sharp peaks and deep valleys isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions on the lower-left white lobe, including one prominent horizontal mark and several smaller unaligned diagonal scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and minor pigmentation spotting on the central white regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique asymmetrical black 'ink-splatter' pigmentation pattern located in the interior upper-left quadrant of the fluke.
